projectSpecs.projectName: Sceptile & Dragonite 1L Heavy-Duty Crochet Tumbler Bag

profileZones.note: Flat circular base reinforced internally with 4 mm (3-5 mm) EVA foam disk
Constant 25.13 cm circumference cylinder hugging the stainless steel barrel
5.5 cm conical taper matching tumbler shoulder angle with zero loose air gap
Locks snug beneath the ~6.5 cm cap flange so case cannot slip upward or sag
Left 100% open for hygienic drinking, cap unscrewing, and built-in lid handle use

componentStrengthRatings.paracord550Core4mm: 249 kg (550 lbs) breaking strength / ~50 kg safe working load
componentStrengthRatings.nylonWebbing15mm: > 90 kg tensile rating; X-box stitched tab pull-out > 25 kg

antiSagAndAntiSlipControls: Internal 1.5 cm x 20 cm Nylon Webbing collar tape overlapped to an 18.0 cm circle (Ø 5.73 cm) inside Zone 4 eliminates radial yarn creep.
Two 1.5 cm vertical Nylon Webbing anchor tabs extend 6.0 cm downward across the 25.5 -> 19.5 cm shoulder-to-cylinder wall so 1.3 kg load bypasses shoulder decreases (< 2 mm vertical elongation).
4mm Paracord 550 drawstring + 2-hole spring cord lock cinches the Zone 4 eyelet round tightly into the Ø 5.6-5.8 cm groove below the ~6.5 cm cap lip.
Optional/recommended Silicone Tumbler Handle Collar Ring (ID 5.5-6.0 cm) provides direct rubberized friction lock on bare stainless steel neck.
Continuous 4mm Paracord 550 core inside both 30 cm short strap and 100 cm Thermal Stitch long strap guarantees 0% permanent strap stretch.
Double-layer Zone 1 base enclosing a Ø 7.8 cm × 4 mm EVA foam (Spon Ati) disk distributes 1.3 kg bottom load and absorbs drop impacts.

hangerFitSystem.collarFitSummary: Engineered specifically for Ø 5.6-5.8 cm neck (circumference 17.6-18.2 cm) below ~6.5 cm cap and Ø 8.0 cm body transition.

drawstringChannel.cordLockStopper: Heavy-duty 2-hole spring cord lock (hole Ø 4.5-5.0 mm for dual 4mm paracord passes)
drawstringChannel.fitAction: Cinched under the ~6.5 cm cap shoulder; locks collar at Ø 5.6-5.8 cm so the case cannot slide upward or gap loosely.

builtInWebbingCollar.collarTapeSize: 1.5 cm wide x 20 cm long (stitched into 18.0 cm closed loop = Ø 5.73 cm)
builtInWebbingCollar.verticalAnchorTabs: 2 pcs x 1.5 cm wide x 15 cm cut length (folded through D-rings, stitched 6.0 cm vertically down onto Ø 8.0 cm body wall with X-box stitch)

siliconeCollarRingOption.fitCheckWarning: MUST specify Wide-Mouth / 18oz-32oz tumbler ring size (Ø 5.5-6.0 cm). Standard 2.8-3.0 cm PET/Aqua bottle rings will NOT fit Cuculemon 1L.

dRings.proportionNote: 1.5 cm width takes only ~8.2% of the 18.2 cm neck circumference per side, preventing bulky overhang caused by oversized 2.5-3.0 cm rings.

swivelLobsterClasps.allocation: 2 pcs on Short Strap (30 cm) + 2 pcs on Long Strap (100 cm)

shortStrap.label: Short Hand-Carry Strap (Tali Pendek)
shortStrap.crochetDetailing: 3.5-4.0 cm tight Polycherry crochet sleeve wraps near each 1.5 cm swivel clasp in character palette colors (concealing paracord splice/whipping)

longStrap.label: Long Crossbody / Shoulder Strap (Tali Panjang)
longStrap.stitchArchitecture: Flat Thermal Stitch crochet strap (8 sts wide ≈ 1.8-2.0 cm, ~460-480 thermal rows) encapsulating a continuous 4mm Paracord 550 spine inside
longStrap.coreTermination: Internal 4mm Paracord 550 passes directly around the 1.5 cm swivel clasp bars at both ends and locks inside Thermal Stitch sleeves

gauge.yarn: Polycherry / Poly Kilap D27 (100% Polyester, ~1.8-2.0 mm, 100g ≈ 150-160 m per gulung)
gauge.hookSizeGuide: 3.0 mm (5/0) for standard single-strand tight bag tension; 4.0-4.5 mm if worked double-stranded
gauge.stitchTechnique: Tight Yarn-Under Single Crochet (YU-SC) for rigid wall density and zero dakron show-through

standardSingleStrand.label: Single-Strand Polycherry D27 (1 Helai, 3.0 mm hook — Verified Standard Gauge)

heavyDutyDoubleStrandEquivalent.label: Double-Strand Polycherry D27 (2 Helai Bersama, 4.0-4.5 mm hook — Matches 36-40 / 26-28 Stitch Benchmark)

gauge.gaugeMathNote: Standard Polycherry D27 single-strand tight gauge is 2.4 sc/cm width x 2.6 rows/cm height (25.13 cm circumference = 60 sc; 18.2 cm neck = 44 sc). Working Polycherry D27 double-stranded (2 ply) yields 1.6 sc/cm x 1.8 rows/cm (25.13 cm = 40 sc; 18.2 cm = 28 sc). Both exact stitch tables are provided in every zone so either method matches the Ø 8.0 cm -> Ø 5.8 cm x 28.0 cm tumbler dimensions accurately. (Note: 4.5 sc/cm would equate to 114 sc at Ø 8.0 cm, typical of fine lace thread rather than D27 yarn.)

zones.title: Zone 1: Reinforced Double-Layer Base Cradle & Hind Feet Anchor
zones.stitches: Single-strand: MR 6 -> R10 = 60 sc | Double-strand: MR 8 -> R5 = 40 sc
zones.rows: Single-strand: 10 rounds + 10 inner base rounds + 1 BLO lock round | Double-strand: 5 rounds + 5 inner rounds + 1 BLO lock
zones.loadBearingNote: Sandwiches a Ø 7.8 cm × 4 mm EVA foam (Spon Ati) disk between outer and inner sc disks before crocheting BLO wall turn. Prevents 1.3 kg stainless steel base from stretching bottom stitches or denting on drop.
instructions: Single-strand (3.0 mm hook): R1 MR 6 sc (6); R2 inc x6 (12); R3 (sc, inc)x6 (18); ... R10 (8 sc, inc)x6 (60). Repeat identical 10 rounds for inner liner disk.
Double-strand alternative (4.5 mm hook): R1 MR 8 sc (8); R2 inc x8 (16); R3 (sc, inc)x8 (24); R4 (2 sc, inc)x8 (32); R5 (3 sc, inc)x8 (40).

Place cut Ø 7.8 cm x 4 mm EVA foam disk between outer base and inner disk, then work R11 (or R6) in BLO catching BOTH outer and inner base loops together (60 sc / 40 sc) to lock a crisp 90° bottom rim.

zones.title: Zone 2: Straight Cylinder Torso, Coral Belly Belt & Tail Base
zones.stitches: Single-strand: 60 sc around | Double-strand: 40 sc around
zones.loadBearingNote: Tight Yarn-Under SC creates a rigid 25.1 cm sleeve hugging the Ø 8.0 cm stainless steel wall. Upper 0.5-1.5 cm of Zone 2 receives the sewn bottom ends of the 2 vertical 1.5 cm Nylon Webbing anchor tabs.
instructions: Work straight cylinder in tight YU-SC: Rows 1-11 (Mint Green).

Coral Belly Belt (approx. 4.5 - 7.8 cm height): Rows 12-19 (single-strand) or Rows 8-13 (double-strand), switch front/side 38 sts (25 sts double-strand) to Coral Red (#D6615D) while keeping back 22 sts Mint Green (or work continuous Coral Red belt band across belly).
Rows 20-52: Continue Mint Green straight body up to 20.0 cm height. Add vertical 3-st Dark Forest Green spine rib down back center (sts 29-31) via surface slip stitch or intarsia.
Chest V-Collar Start (17.5 - 20.0 cm): On Rows 46-52 at front center, begin Dark Forest Green V-dip line converging toward front center stitch.

zones.title: Zone 3: Tapered Shoulder, V-Collar Apex & Internal Webbing Load Bridge
zones.stitches: Single-strand: 60 sc -> 44 sc | Double-strand: 40 sc -> 28 sc
zones.loadBearingNote: CRITICAL: Never rely solely on shoulder decreases to suspend 1.3 kg. Before closing Zone 4, stitch the 6.0 cm vertical tails of the two 1.5 cm Nylon Webbing anchor tabs along the left (3 o'clock) and right (9 o'clock) internal walls from 25.5 cm down to 19.5 cm on the Ø 8.0 cm cylinder using X-box nylon stitches.
instructions: Single-strand decrease schedule (14 rows, 60 -> 44 sc): R1-2 sc 60; R3 (13 sc, dec)x4 (56); R4-5 sc 56; R6 (12 sc, dec)x4 (52); R7-8 sc 52; R9 (11 sc, dec)x4 (48); R10-11 sc 48; R12 (10 sc, dec)x4 (44); R13-14 sc 44.
Double-strand decrease schedule (10 rows, 40 -> 28 sc): R1 sc 40; R2 (8 sc, dec)x4 (36); R3-4 sc 36; R5 (7 sc, dec)x4 (32); R6-7 sc 32; R8 (6 sc, dec)x4 (28); R9-10 sc 28.
Complete Dark Forest Green V-collar border lines wrapping from left/right shoulder edges down to a crisp central V-tip at ~19.5 cm height.
Test-fit over the Cuculemon 1L tumbler before Zone 4: shoulder must sit flush along the 20.0-25.5 cm stainless steel taper.

zones.title: Zone 4: Neck Collar, Paracord 550 Drawstring Channel & 1.5 cm D-Ring Hanger
zones.loadBearingNote: Primary suspension hub: 1.5 cm x 20 cm Nylon Webbing collar tape forms an 18.0 cm (Ø 5.73 cm) non-stretch inner ring stitched behind the crochet collar. Two 1.5 cm Metal D-Rings (3.0 mm wire) sit at left/right sides on folded 1.5 cm webbing tabs anchored 6 cm down onto Zone 2-3. Leaves 28.0-32.0 cm lid/handle open.
instructions: Rows 1-2: Work 44 sc (28 sc double-strand) evenly at Ø 5.8 cm.

Row 3 (Drawstring Eyelet Round): Single-strand: [sc 2, ch 1, sk 1] x14, sc 2 (creates 14 reinforced eyelets around neck; keep 2 eyelets centered at front for cord lock exit). Double-strand: [sc 1, ch 1, sk 1] x14.
Rows 4-7: Work 44 sc (28 sc) tightly over the top rim, finishing Row 7 with reverse sc (crab stitch) or slip-stitch edge at exactly 28.0 cm height.

Hardware & Fit Installation: (1) Sew internal 1.5 cm x 20 cm Nylon Webbing collar tape inside Rows 4-6; (2) Thread both 1.5 cm D-Rings onto 15 cm webbing anchor tabs and X-box stitch 6 cm down sides; (3) Weave 65 cm of 4mm Paracord 550 through Row 3 eyelets and attach 2-hole spring cord lock; (4) Seat optional Ø 5.5-6.0 cm Silicone Tumbler Ring at the 26-27.5 cm neck groove beneath the ~6.5 cm cap.

zones.title: Zone 5: Front Collar Sceptile Head Relief, Crest & Slit Eyes (Open-Lid Safe)
zones.diameterRangeCm: Front arc relief (~7.5 cm wide x 6.5 cm tall; top opening remains 100% free)
zones.stitches: Front relief dome: MR 6 -> 30 sc half-shell + 2 pointed head crests (MR 4 -> 14 sc cones)
zones.rows: Snout/face relief 12 rows + 2 crests x 8 rows + lower jaw 4 rows
zones.loadBearingNote: Mounted strictly on the front wall of Zones 3-4 below the 28.0 cm lip (avoiding left/right D-rings and drawstring exit), keeping the 28.0-32.0 cm tumbler cap unscrewable.
instructions: Sculpted Snout & Brow Relief: Crochet a flattened oval snout/face dome in Mint Green (MR 6 -> 30 sc), stuff lightly with Dakron, and shape subtle brow ridge with Coral Red (#D6615D) crescent lower jaw tucked underneath.

Pointed Twin Head Crests (2 pcs): MR 4 sc, gradually inc to 14 sc over 8 rows; flatten slightly and sew angled upward-outward along upper sides of front collar (stopping flush with or slightly flanking the 28 cm neck without overhanging cap removal).

Slanted Eyes (2 pcs): Cut/crochet Warm Yellow (#E4D17C) almond shapes (ch 5, sc/hdc/sc around), embroider vertical Jet Black (#1F2421) slit pupils and Coral Red lower eyelid rim, stitch symmetrically onto snout sides.

zones.title: Zone 6: 3D Back Seeds, Leaf Tail, Wrist Leaf Blades, Legs & Paracord-Core Straps
zones.heightRangeCm: Appended across Zones 1-3 + detachable 30 cm & 100 cm straps
zones.diameterRangeCm: Seeds Ø 2.3 cm; Tail length 16 cm; Short Strap 30 cm; Long Strap 100 cm
zones.stitches: Seeds: MR 6 -> 18 sc; Tail stem: MR 6 -> 24 sc; Thermal Long Strap: 8 sts wide
zones.rows: 6 Seeds x 7 rows; Tail 26 rows + 12 leaf blades; Short Strap 30 cm; Long Strap ~470 thermal rows
zones.loadBearingNote: All 3D amigurumi appendages are sewn purely onto the outer crochet shell (never pierced through internal nylon webbing) and must be densely stuffed with Dakron so tail/limbs hold shape against 1.3 kg bag weight. Straps carry load solely via internal 4mm Paracord 550 cores hooked to 1.5 cm swivel clasps.
instructions: 6 Yellow Back Seeds (6 pcs): MR 6 -> 12 -> 18 -> 18 -> 18 -> 12 -> 6 sc in Warm Yellow (#E4D17C), stuff firmly with Dakron; sew in 2 vertical columns of 3 seeds along upper/mid back (13-23 cm height).

Leaf Tail: Crochet tapering Mint Green core cone (MR 6 -> 24 sc over 26 rows, curved slightly upward at 30°, firmly stuffed with Dakron); attach layered serrated leaf fan blades (upper pair Dark Forest Green #438D5A, lower pair Mint Green #68C481, each worked in ch+sc/hdc/dc picot spikes) and stitch tail base broadly at 3.0-9.0 cm back center.

Arms & Dual Wrist Leaf Blades (2 sets): Tubes MR 6 -> 12 sc x 14 rows with 3-claw hand tips; on each forearm stitch 2 flat leaf blades (1 tall 6 cm Mint Green + 1 smaller 4.5 cm Dark Forest Green) pointing upward; attach arms at 18.5-20.5 cm sides.

Muscular Hind Legs & 3-Toed Feet (2 pcs): MR 6 -> 24 sc tapered thigh x 10 rows + 3-toed webbed foot pad, stitched symmetrically to lower Zone 1-2 front sides (0-6 cm) so tumbler case stands upright on a table.

Interchangeable Straps: (A) 30 cm Short Strap = braided/twisted 4mm Paracord 550 core clipped into two 1.5 cm swivel clasps with 4 cm Emerald/Coral/Yellow crochet sleeves locking ends; (B) 100 cm Long Strap = 8-st wide (~1.9 cm) flat Thermal Stitch strap in Emerald + Coral edge stripes with continuous 4mm Paracord 550 core looped through two 1.5 cm swivel clasps.

zones.title: Zone 1: Reinforced Double-Layer Base Cradle & Heavy Foot Anchor
zones.stitches: Single-strand: MR 6 -> R10 = 60 sc | Double-strand: MR 8 -> R5 = 40 sc
zones.rows: Single-strand: 10 rounds + 10 inner base rounds + 1 BLO lock round | Double-strand: 5 rounds + 5 inner rounds + 1 BLO lock
zones.loadBearingNote: Identical Ø 7.8 cm × 4 mm EVA foam (Spon Ati) disk sandwiched between outer and inner sc disks and locked via BLO round. Supports 1.3 kg vertical load without bowing.
instructions: Single-strand (3.0 mm hook): Work R1-R10 in Golden Orange (MR 6 -> 60 sc). Make matching 60 sc inner disk.
Double-strand alternative (4.5 mm hook): Work R1-R5 in Golden Orange (MR 8 -> 40 sc) + matching 40 sc inner disk.
Insert Ø 7.8 cm x 4 mm EVA foam cushion between disks, then work BLO lock round catching both disks together (60 sc / 40 sc) to create a flat, non-sagging foundation.

zones.title: Zone 2: Straight Cylinder Torso & Ribbed Cream Front Belly Panel
zones.stitches: Single-strand: 60 sc around | Double-strand: 40 sc around
zones.loadBearingNote: Tight YU-SC cylinder maintains exact 25.13 cm circumference. Ribbed Cream belly panel adds front double-layer stiffness without altering inner Ø 8.0 cm diameter.
instructions: Work straight Golden Orange cylinder for 52 rows (36 rows double-strand) up to 20.0 cm height.

Ribbed Cream Belly Panel (front 1.0 - 20.0 cm): Crochet separately as a curved-bottom tapered front panel in Warm Cream (#EAD8B3) using alternating BLO rows every 2nd row to form 11 crisp horizontal belly ribs (widest ~18 sts / 7.5 cm at belly center, tapering gently to 12 sts / 5.0 cm at chest top).

Alternatively integrate Warm Cream via tapestry/intarsia across front 18 sts (12 sts double-strand) with horizontal surface slip-stitch ribs every 4 rows; stitch panel securely onto front cylinder so tumbler still slides in effortlessly.

zones.title: Zone 3: Tapered Shoulder, Throat Rib Taper, Wings & Internal Webbing Bridge
zones.stitches: Single-strand: 60 sc -> 44 sc | Double-strand: 40 sc -> 28 sc
zones.loadBearingNote: CRITICAL: Two 1.5 cm Nylon Webbing vertical anchor tabs run from the Zone 4 D-rings downward for 6.0 cm across Zone 3 onto the top of Zone 2 (25.5 -> 19.5 cm), X-box stitched firmly with extra-strong nylon thread. Wings attach slightly toward rear dorsal shoulder (10 o'clock & 2 o'clock) so they never obstruct the 3 o'clock / 9 o'clock D-rings.
instructions: Single-strand decrease schedule (14 rows, 60 -> 44 sc): R1-2 sc 60; R3 (13 sc, dec)x4 (56); R4-5 sc 56; R6 (12 sc, dec)x4 (52); R7-8 sc 52; R9 (11 sc, dec)x4 (48); R10-11 sc 48; R12 (10 sc, dec)x4 (44); R13-14 sc 44.
Double-strand decrease schedule (10 rows, 40 -> 28 sc): R1 sc 40; R2 (8 sc, dec)x4 (36); R3-4 sc 36; R5 (7 sc, dec)x4 (32); R6-7 sc 32; R8 (6 sc, dec)x4 (28); R9-10 sc 28.
Taper front Warm Cream ribbed throat extension smoothly up to 25.5 cm (width ~10 sts / 4.0 cm) right under Dragonite's chin relief.

zones.title: Zone 4: Neck Collar, Paracord 550 Drawstring Channel & 1.5 cm D-Ring Hanger
zones.loadBearingNote: 1.5 cm x 20 cm Nylon Webbing collar tape stitched inside Rows 4-6 creates an 18.0 cm (Ø 5.73 cm) non-stretch ring supporting 1.3 kg via two 1.5 cm Metal D-Rings (3.0 mm wire). Leaves 28.0-32.0 cm lid/handle open.
instructions: Rows 1-2: 44 sc (28 sc double-strand) around Ø 5.8 cm neck.
Row 3 (Drawstring Eyelet Round): Single-strand: [sc 2, ch 1, sk 1] x14, sc 2. Double-strand: [sc 1, ch 1, sk 1] x14.
Rows 4-7: 44 sc (28 sc) tightly over top cuff, ending with clean slip-stitch rim at 28.0 cm height.

Install 1.5 cm x 20 cm internal Nylon Webbing loop, fold 2 x 15 cm webbing anchor tabs through the 1.5 cm D-Rings and X-box stitch 6 cm down left/right sides, weave 65 cm 4mm Paracord 550 + 2-hole spring cord lock, and fit optional Ø 5.5-6.0 cm Silicone Tumbler Ring under the ~6.5 cm cap.

zones.title: Zone 5: Front Collar Dragonite Snout, Oval Eyes, Horn & 2 S-Curved Antennae
zones.heightRangeCm: 22.0 - 28.0 (front collar relief; keeps 28.0-32.0 cm lid unobstructed)
zones.diameterRangeCm: Front arc relief (~7.5 cm wide x 6.0 cm tall)
zones.stitches: Snout dome: MR 6 -> 30 sc; Horn: MR 4 -> 10 sc; Antennae: 4-5 sc spiral i-cord tubes
zones.rows: Snout 10 rows; Horn 5 rows; 2 Antennae x 16 rows
zones.loadBearingNote: Attached strictly to front chest/collar wall (22.0-28.0 cm). Horn & 2 antennae lean gently outward/forward from the 27.5 cm front rim so cap removal at 28.0-32.0 cm is effortless.
instructions: Rounded Snout & Cheeks: Crochet a plump Golden Orange snout (MR 6 -> 30 sc, 10 rows, stuffed firmly with Dakron), embroider two tiny nostrils and gentle smile arc, sew centered at 22.5-26.5 cm.
Oval Eyes (2 pcs): Oval iris in Deep Teal/Olive (#167B75) + Jet Black (#1F2421) vertical oval pupil + crisp Off-White (#DCE0E5) side crescent highlight, stitched symmetrically above snout.
Central Forehead Horn: Tiny cone in Golden Orange (MR 4 -> 6 -> 8 -> 10 sc over 5 rows) centered at 27.5 cm rim.

Twin S-Curved Antennae (2 pcs): Work tight 4-sc or 5-sc spiral tubes in Warm Cream (#EAD8B3) for 16 rows (~6.5 cm long); insert twisted spare Polycherry cord inside and shape into gentle upward S-curves flanking the forehead horn.

zones.title: Zone 6: 2-Tone Wings, Plump Tail with Ribbed Underside, Clawed Limbs & Straps
zones.heightRangeCm: Appended across Zones 1-3 + detachable 30 cm & 100 cm straps
zones.diameterRangeCm: Tail length 17 cm; Wing span ~9.5 cm each; Short Strap 30 cm; Long Strap 100 cm
zones.stitches: Tail: MR 6 -> 34 sc; Wing membrane: row-worked scalloped bat-wing + orange rim; Thermal Long Strap: 8 sts wide
zones.rows: Tail 32 rows; Wings 14 rows each; 12 Claws x 4 rows; Short Strap 30 cm; Long Strap ~470 thermal rows
zones.loadBearingNote: Plump tail & 2-tone wings are sewn strictly onto outer crochet fabric (never piercing webbing straps) and balanced symmetrically so the 1.3 kg tumbler bag hangs upright without tipping backward.
instructions: 2-Tone Dragonite Wings (2 pcs, Mirror Left & Right): Crochet inner bat-wing membrane in Deep Ocean Teal (#167B75) with 3 scalloped bottom points (14 rows), back layer in Golden Orange (#EC9D41) with raised top wing-bone ridge, sc-join both layers together around perimeter with Golden Orange edging (optional thin 2 mm EVA trim inside upper leading edge for crisp wing flare). Attach to upper back shoulder at 18.0-24.5 cm angled slightly back.

Plump Tail with Ribbed Cream Underside: Crochet tapering cone in Golden Orange (MR 6 -> 34 sc over 32 rows, stuffed densely with Dakron to curve upward 17 cm without dragging); crochet a tapered Warm Cream (#EAD8B3) ribbed panel (8 BLO ribs) along the underside curve as seen on rear view; sew broad tail root across back 2.0-9.5 cm.

Clawed Arms & Feet (2 arms + 2 sturdy feet): Work chunky Golden Orange arms (MR 6 -> 16 sc x 13 rows) and rounded legs/feet (MR 6 -> 22 sc x 12 rows); crochet 12 tiny Off-White (#DCE0E5) conical claws (MR 4 -> 6 sc, 4 rows) — 3 per hand, 3 per foot — sew firmly onto limb tips. Anchor feet at Zone 1-2 front lower corners (0-6 cm) and arms at 17.5-20.5 cm.

Interchangeable Straps: (A) 30 cm Short Strap = twisted/braided 4mm Paracord 550 core clipped into two 1.5 cm swivel clasps with 4 cm Golden Orange/Cream/Teal crochet clasp sleeves; (B) 100 cm Long Strap = 8-st wide (~1.9 cm) flat Thermal Stitch strap in Golden Orange with Cream center rib & Teal border accent, encapsulating a continuous 4mm Paracord 550 core looped into both 1.5 cm swivel clasps.
